messages:
Mel (sec): FYI pentest/ASV flagged two things that might collide: (1) our RBAC rollouts changed how service principals are represented across regions, and (2) a handshake downgrade path exists if a proxy can't access new certs. We should do a focused sweep before any further rotations.
Anya (eng-infra): can you paste the failing sample or repro steps? I can run a quick cross-region assume-role test.
Mel (sec): repro in ap-south-1 during a canary cert rotation:
```
2026-04-01T18:34:11Z proxy-ap-south-3 ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:777777:key/cc-dd-ee
principal=arn:aws:sts::777777:assumed-role/svc-proxy-ap-session-99 req=trace-9c
handshake=TLSv1.3 fallback to TLSv1.2 detected
```
Victor (oncall): quick triage: AccessDenied + fallback indicates key policy/assume-role mismatch. If proxy can't decrypt, it might present an older cert or restart; either can trigger the downgrade. What's the RBAC change you rolled? 
Mel (sec): PR 4621 replaced long-lived delegated roles with region-scoped service account federation (OIDC). Good for least privilege, but we didn't update KMS key policies in all regions; some keys still reference the old role ARNs.
Sam (platform): mitigation options: (A) add a short-lived emergency key policy grant scoped to the new service-account principal in the affected region(s); (B) revert federation change in the rotation path; (C) update rotation tooling to check key-policy mapping pre-rotation. Prefer (A)+(C) for speed.
Ivy (sre): immediate soft-fail mitigation: bump proxy env CERT_CACHE_TTL to 900s and enable strict-fallback=false so proxies don't negotiate down to weaker ciphers. We can push a small canary.
Anya (eng-infra): sample quick key-policy snippet we can apply as a temporary emergency grant (terraform override):
```
{
  "Sid": "TempAllowSvcAcctDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::777777:role/oidc-proxy-ap-svcaccount"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestedRegion":"ap-south-1"}}
}
```
Mel (sec): if we add a temp grant please tag it with incident_id=inc-20260401-handshake-sweep and put expiration (30m). Compliance wants the justification in the terraform change and a linked audit entry.
Victor (oncall): applying temp grant now and restarting a canary set. deploy-bot: starting rollout proxy-ap-south canary v7.8.1 -> v7.8.2 (1/1 updated).
deploy-bot: rollout complete  canary healthy.
Victor (oncall): after temp grant + canary restart, cert unwraps ok. No more TLS fallback in the canary logs.
Sam (platform): long term fixes: 1) key-policy sweep to replace role ARNs with OIDC-based principals or add kms:ViaService + aws:RequestedRegion conditions; 2) enhance rotation job to pre-validate key-policy mappings and fail safe; 3) add unit/integration tests for assume-role vs service-account flows across regions; 4) update runbook to require a key-policy check before any mass rotation.
Mel (sec): also adding security requirements: log KMS fields on every unwrap attempt (assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id) and add structured incident tags (incident_id, ci_correlation_id). Turn on higher retention for keystore audit logs for 90 days for this class of incidents.
Ivy (sre): I'll add alert rules: keystore.decrypt_fail > 3% over 5m -> page SRE; keystore.tls_fallback_count > 0 -> page oncall. Also will make proxy default to refuse TLS downgrade when keystore errors are observed.
Anya (eng-infra): opening RFC for a safe key-policy migration: map old role ARNs -> OIDC principals; include terraform automation that writes a temporary grant with explicit expiry when hosting a rotation; add smoke-tests that run against staging keys.
Mel (sec): scheduling a vuln triage with sec/infra/platform tomorrow 09:30 UTC — we'll build the RCA and a policy migration plan. Assign INC-20260401-01 for tracking.
Victor (oncall): monitoring 60m, will roll the temp grant off after confirm. If anything else pops up ping @here.
blitz-bot: Incident INC-20260401-01 created and audit record linked.
